caption: The video captures a close-up, fixed view of a chrome espresso machine mid-extraction. A polished portafilter sits centered above a small clear glass, which rests on a transparent acrylic holder over a metal drip tray. A thin, steady stream of brown coffee falls continuously from the portafilter spout into the glass below. The glass already holds a layered column of coffee, with dark liquid beneath a lighter tan crema, indicating the pour began before this excerpt. As the stream continues, the liquid level rises slowly and the pale crema layer thickens and creeps upward. The black portafilter handle projects diagonally to the right and remains motionless throughout. The glass, stand, and tray stay fixed in place. The bright, out-of-focus white background shows only faint reflections of the machine. No camera movement occurs, and the extraction is still underway at the final frame.
